# finalize.export_to_geotiff { #healpyxel.finalize.export_to_geotiff }

```python
finalize.export_to_geotiff(df, column, output_path, nside, crs='IAU:19900')
```

Export a HEALPix column to GeoTIFF format.

Creates an equirectangular projection raster from the HEALPix-gridded
data using ``healpy.ang2pix`` for the reprojection. Default output
resolution is 1440×720 (0.25° per pixel).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description                                                                                 | Default       |
|-------------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| df          | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame with ``healpix_id`` as index or column.                                           | _required_    |
| column      | str          | Data column to export.                                                                      | _required_    |
| output_path | Path         | Output GeoTIFF file path.                                                                   | _required_    |
| nside       | int          | HEALPix nside parameter of the source data.                                                 | _required_    |
| crs         | str          | CRS string for the output GeoTIFF. Default: ``'IAU:19900'`` (Mercury IAU body-fixed frame). | `'IAU:19900'` |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type        | Description                                     |
|--------|-------------|-------------------------------------------------|
|        | ImportError | If ``rasterio`` or ``healpy`` is not available. |
